no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Accustem Sciences is a clinical-stage diagnostics company developing genomic tests for oncology — Molecular Signature Classifier (MSC) for lung-nodule screening and StemPrintER (a 20-gene prognostic signature validated in TransATAC and other cohorts for early-stage breast cancer outcomes).
